released_ELF_policy: Official runner hashes before/after native execution and records release. Retired bytes are not claimed present or archived.
binary_binding_policy: Actual V9 verified source/producer/runtime/executable identities at closure. Export and standalone reader never reopen binary paths and never claim retired bytes present.
raw_path_identity: Exact (original_path, expected SHA256), with the SHA-pinned D2 default portable as an immutable raw authority. Old f5, D2 default and current all-features watcher versions may coexist without rewriting owner paths.
mode_policy: Actual all-features native PASS/FAIL/ignored counts remain literal. 9116 eligible historical PASS IDs pass all-features; four exact cfg-disabled IDs separately pass in the actual same-source D2 default proof. The older baseline is 6397 eligible plus two default-only. These default-only IDs are never all-features native passes.
focused_provenance_policy: The actual 40-PASS focused checkpoint and two earlier RED attempts remain inside the exact default portable proof as separate provenance and are not additional all-features executions.
decode: Existing V7 base64(zlib(exact bytes)) format. The independent reader validates actual 108-target all-features metadata/Cargo/source/raw outcomes and partition unions, mode-qualified historical IDs, all70 controls and the exact complete D2 default portable proof.
